files.description: Hourly weather for the city, September 2025 (720 rows, one per hour in time order, no gaps): observed_at (timestamp written as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), temp_c (degrees C, one decimal; about 2% empty), rain_mm (one decimal), wind_kmh (whole number), sky (clear, cloudy, fog or rain; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Reshape weather_hourly.csv into long form with one row per hour and measurement, covering temp_c, rain_mm and wind_kmh. `result` should be a table with columns observed_at, measure (the column name) and value, empty temperatures dropped, sorted by observed_at and then by measure alphabetically, with a fresh row numbering from 0.
intended_computation: Read weather_hourly.csv; long form with one row per (hour, measure) for temp_c, rain_mm, wind_kmh; columns observed_at, measure (the column name), value; rows with an empty temp_c dropped; sorted by observed_at, then measure alphabetically; default index 0..n-1.

acceptable_variants.notes: observed_at may be timestamps instead of text; value may be float throughout
